description: TEST FIXTURE for workspace_roots (2026-10-21). Proves that a second folder opened in a VS Code multi-root workspace is treated EXACTLY like the CWD by the path policy: file writes / redirects / the strictness-gated path guard allow under it instead of asking. Only the VS Code (Copilot) IDE may use it. Roots are declared explicitly here (discover is [] to keep runs hermetic and filesystem independent).
_comment_log_file_path: Keep hook records from the e2e spawn out of the real ~/.pretoolhook logs.
_comment_ask_notification: Off: the e2e case intentionally produces an ask decision and must not toast.
_comment_workspace_roots: CWD for every case is d:\work. d:\other-repo plays the role of the second VS Code workspace folder. discover is empty so no real %APPDATA% scan happens in tests - discovery is exercised against a fake storage root by Run-Tests.ps1.
_comment_editable_paths: Enabled (non-empty) on purpose: with editable_paths declared, Resolve-PathPolicy loses the 'normal mode without editable_paths' fallback allow, so a foreign absolute path really does ask. That is the exact production shape that made the reported 'path-guard denied' fire.
